scope: Synthetic offline hypothesis validation; not production detector implementation
thresholds: Experimental choices, not values endorsed by the cited experts

candidates.name: regular_outbound_connections
candidates.decision: Do not enable as standalone attack detection
candidates.reason: Identical cadence flags benign health checks; process/peer context and real benign validation required.
candidates.telemetry_gap: Need event-time flow observations, SYN retransmission deduplication and stable process identity.

candidates.name: tcp_rejection_burst
candidates.decision: Candidate operational anomaly; not validated for live integration
candidates.reason: Broken clients also trigger. Need matched SYN/RST evidence and real traffic validation; never label brute force.
candidates.telemetry_gap: Context drops TCP sequence/ack numbers and has no connection outcome tracker.

candidates.name: dns_resolver_policy_deviation
candidates.decision: Requires explicitly configured resolver policy before integration
candidates.reason: No policy means unknown. Public DNS is not inherently malicious; HTTPS alone cannot establish DoH.
candidates.telemetry_gap: No approved resolver policy or VPN/network-change handling configured.

release_gate: Preserve capture timestamps and connection identity; test retries, IPv6, missing packets and restarts.
Replay labelled positive samples and separate representative benign Windows traffic without transmitting them.
Measure missed cases and false alerts per host-day on held-out data; do not tune and score on the same traces.
Demonstrate bounded memory, duplicate suppression, persistence and truthful UI explanations.
Only then integrate the candidate; no automatic blocking from these patterns.
